summary_1line: Victor leaves Geneva after his mother dies of scarlet fever, arrives at Ingolstadt, and becomes inspired by Professor Waldman to pursue ambitious scientific discovery.

image_candidates.scene_text: On her deathbed, Victor's mother joins the hands of Elizabeth and Victor, blessing their future union as the family gathers in grief.
Professor Waldman stands before a lecture hall demonstrating chemistry experiments as Victor listens, transfixed by the promise of mastering nature.
Victor arrives alone at night in Ingolstadt, gazing up at the town’s high white steeple before entering his solitary apartment.
